page.title: Meet someone in person
page.intro: Show your code to someone you're with.
page.introTip: If they're new here, they join with it. If they already have an account, they scan it while signed in and you become friends.

budget.available: {count, plural, =0 {No invites saved} one {# invite saved} other {# invites saved}} (up to {cap})
budget.full: Your invites are full. Use one before more can build up.
budget.probationIntro: You can't invite new people yet, but you can still become friends in person.
budget.probationFriends: {count, plural, one {# more acquaintance} other {# more acquaintances}} outside your invite tree
budget.revoked: You can no longer invite people.
budget.probationFriendsPlus: {count, plural, one {# more friend} other {# more friends}} outside your invite tree (met in person)

attempts.left: Code attempts: {count, number} of {cap, number} left
attempts.hint: Showing a code uses an attempt, even if nobody joins. Used attempts come back one at a time.

countdown.days: {d, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} {h, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}
countdown.hours: {h, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} {m, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}
countdown.minutes: {m, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} {s, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}

open.connectOnly: Right now your code only works for people who already have an account: you become friends. New people can't join with it yet.

hs.scanHint: Ask them to open {url} on their phone and scan this code. If they already have an account, they scan it signed in.
hs.claimed: Someone scanned your code. Check that their screen shows the same number:
hs.confirmed: Waiting for them to create their account…
hs.doneRecovery: Done. The account's recovery can continue.
hs.doneAccepted: They joined! You're now acquaintances. Meet again with sound to become friends.
hs.doneAcquaintances: Done! You're now acquaintances. Meet again with sound to become friends.

errors.no_invites: You have no invites saved right now.
errors.on_probation: New accounts can't invite anyone yet.
errors.friend_cap: You have reached the limit of 1,000 acquaintances and open requests.
errors.mode_unsupported: This kind of invite isn't available yet.

mode.quiet: Quiet: only the near-silent tone, no jingle
mode.dual: Without sound: each phone scans the other's code

sound.listening: Listening… Ask them to tap "Play the sound" with their phone close to yours.
sound.listeningQuiet: Listening for the near-silent tone… Ask them to tap "Play the sound" with their phone close to yours.
sound.noMic: We couldn't use your microphone. Allow microphone access, or cancel and choose the option without sound.

dual.hint: Now let them scan this second code.

outcome.retryVolume: We couldn't hear it. Ask them to turn their volume up and play it again.
outcome.retryJingle: We couldn't hear the quiet tone. Ask them to switch the jingle on and play it again.
outcome.noAttempts: No tries left. Cancel and show a new code.

sign.askInvite: Sign the invite with your passkey.
sign.askUpgrade: Sign the friendship record with your passkey.
sign.summaryInvite: You invite this person and become friends.
sign.summaryUpgrade: You and your acquaintance become friends.
sign.waitingInvitee: Signed. Waiting for them to finish…
sign.waitingFriend: Signed. Waiting for them to sign…
